analyst.summary: Sonata Software's recent profit growth (up over 20% year-on-year) is coming from margin improvement and mix-shift toward higher-value cloud, data and AI work, not from revenue growth, which has been close to flat in a soft global IT-spending environment. The company continues to win large multi-year deals and is building a meaningful AI-related pipeline, and a planned CEO transition is underway. We see this as a capital-efficient business navigating a genuinely weak topline environment reasonably well, priced fairly for that reality rather than for a sharp recovery.
